source.title: Delay notice from Penang PowerTech logistics desk (synthetic)

events.raw_text: Dear Kaveri team, due to an unplanned shutdown at Zenith Wafer Fab (our die supplier's Kulim fab) on 24 Oct 2026, shipment SHP-A-0901 under PO-7001 (900 x PM-750) will depart Port Klang on 02 Nov 2026 instead of 26 Oct 2026, a delay of 7 days. We are invoking the force majeure clause of PO-7001. Regards, Penang PowerTech Logistics.
